sourceSnapshot.text: Total revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased by $438.3 million, or 479%, from $91.5 million in 2024 to $529.8 million in 2025. This increase was predominantly driven by the revenues generated by our core AI cloud business, Nebius, and to a lesser extent, growth in TripleTen.
